plans.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM patients t WHERE t.practice_id=$1 AND t.location_id=$2
SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM documents t WHERE t.practice_id=$1 AND t.location_id=$2

SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.status NOT IN('cancelled','completed','no_show'))::text AS active,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.status='checked_in')::text AS checked_in,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.status NOT IN('cancelled','completed','no_show') AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM visit_requirements r WHERE r.appointment_id=t.id AND r.practice_id=t.practice_id AND r.location_id=t.location_id AND r.required AND r.lifecycle_state='active' AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM requirement_evidence e JOIN document_versions v ON v.id=e.document_version_id AND v.patient_id=r.patient_id AND v.practice_id=r.practice_id AND v.location_id=r.location_id
 JOIN documents d ON d.id=v.document_id AND d.archived_at IS NULL JOIN file_objects f ON f.id=v.file_object_id AND f.status='available'
 WHERE e.requirement_id=r.id AND e.revoked_at IS NULL
 AND (r.required_template_version_id IS NULL OR r.required_template_version_id=v.template_version_id)
 AND (r.maximum_age_days IS NULL OR COALESCE(v.completed_at,f.uploaded_at,v.received_at)>=t.scheduled_at-make_interval(days=>r.maximum_age_days))
 AND (NOT r.review_required OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_reviews review WHERE review.id=e.accepted_review_id AND review.document_version_id=v.id AND review.decision='accepted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_reviews next_review WHERE next_review.supersedes_review_id=review.id)))
 AND (NOT r.signature_required OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM signature_packets packet WHERE packet.output_version_id=v.id AND packet.state='completed'))
 )))::text AS needs_documents FROM appointments t WHERE t.practice_id=$1 AND t.location_id=$2 AND t.scheduled_at>=($3::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE (SELECT time_zone FROM locations WHERE id=$2 AND practice_id=$1)) AND t.scheduled_at<(($3::date+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE (SELECT time_zone FROM locations WHERE id=$2 AND practice_id=$1))

Plans.Index Cond: ((practice_id = '222e264d-604e-40f0-9598-f811269e633d'::uuid) AND (location_id = 'f20ea0cc-89a0-4a9c-9388-cea9b285e335'::uuid) AND (scheduled_at >= ('2026-10-18 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE (InitPlan 7).col1)) AND (scheduled_at < ('2026-10-19 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE (InitPlan 8).col1)))

Plans.Filter: (required AND (lifecycle_state = 'active'::text) AND careiq_clinical_scope(practice_id, location_id) AND (NOT EXISTS(SubPlan 5)))

Plans.Index Cond: ((id = e.document_version_id) AND (patient_id = r.patient_id) AND (practice_id = r.practice_id) AND (location_id = r.location_id))
Plans.Filter: (((r.required_template_version_id IS NULL) OR (r.required_template_version_id = template_version_id)) AND ((careiq_clinical_scope(practice_id, location_id) AND (location_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.location_id'::text))) OR careiq_patient_scope('document_versions'::text, to_jsonb(v.*))) AND ((NOT r.signature_required) OR EXISTS(SubPlan 3)) AND ((NOT r.review_required) OR EXISTS(SubPlan 1)))

((output_version_id = v.id) AND (state = 'completed'::text) AND ((careiq_clinical_scope(practice_id, location_id) AND (location_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.location_id'::text))) OR careiq_patient_scope('signature_packets'::text, to_jsonb(packet.*))))
((document_version_id = v.id) AND (decision = 'accepted'::text) AND careiq_clinical_scope(practice_id, location_id) AND (location_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.location_id'::text)))

((archived_at IS NULL) AND ((careiq_clinical_scope(practice_id, location_id) AND (location_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.location_id'::text))) OR careiq_patient_scope('documents'::text, to_jsonb(d.*))))

((status = 'available'::text) AND ((careiq_clinical_scope(practice_id, location_id) AND (location_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.location_id'::text))) OR careiq_patient_scope('file_objects'::text, to_jsonb(f.*))) AND ((r.maximum_age_days IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(v.completed_at, uploaded_at, v.received_at) >= (t.scheduled_at - make_interval(0, 0, 0, r.maximum_age_days, 0, 0, '0'::double precision)))))

SELECT v.*,v.created_at::text AS __careiq_created_at FROM (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id,document_type_id FROM visit_requirements WHERE practice_id=$1 AND location_id=$2 AND id=ANY($3::uuid[])) r JOIN LATERAL(
 SELECT candidate.* FROM documents d JOIN LATERAL(SELECT version.* FROM document_versions version WHERE version.document_id=d.id AND version.practice_id=$1 AND version.location_id=$2 ORDER BY version.created_at DESC,version.id DESC LIMIT 1) candidate ON true
 WHERE d.practice_id=$1 AND d.location_id=$2 AND d.patient_id=r.patient_id AND d.document_type_id=r.document_type_id AND d.archived_at IS NULL
 ORDER BY candidate.created_at DESC,candidate.id DESC LIMIT 1
 ) v ON true
